kiel-eutin-luebeck-bay-old-road.story: Lake-country bends with a bay view if the wind behaves. The best part sits around Preetz gate, Eutin lake road, Timmendorf bay view, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.
